You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn't already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature.
Brutal: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die.

items.name: Ring of Resistance

items.name: Phoenix Feather

items.name: Box of Many Goods
items.description: Once per long rest, you can open this small box and roll a d12. On a result of 1–6, it's empty. On a result of 7–10, it contains one random common consumable. On a result of 11–12, it contains two random common consumables.

items.name: Portal Seed

items.name: Elusive Amulet

items.description: Trusty: +1 to attack rolls made with your primary weapon.

items.name: Vorpal Shard
items.description: Targeted: When you fail a weapon attack, you can spend a Hope to succeed on your next weapon attack.

items.name: Soul Chain
items.description: Draining: On a successful attack, you can spend a Hope to force the target to mark a Stress. If they do, you clear a Stress.

items.name: War Dart
items.description: Versatile: This weapon can also be used with these statistics—Agility, Melee, d8+5.

items.name: Legendary Hatchet
items.description: Follow-Up: On a successful attack with your primary weapon within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for this attack.

items.name: Legendary Offhand Brass Knuckles
items.description: Paired: +5 to primary weapon damage to targets within Melee range.

items.name: Legendary Throwing Knives
items.description: Stockpiled: You can throw this weapon within Close range by making an attack roll using Finesse. You don't have to retrieve it, as you always have another on hand.

items.name: Legendary Fighting Cloak
items.description: Padded: +5 to damage thresholds.

items.name: Legendary Rune Shield
items.description: Protective: +4 to Armor Score.

items.name: Legendary Focus Runes
items.description: Focused: +1 to primary weapon damage to targets within Very Close range.

items.name: Void Needle
items.description: Inverted: When you roll a weapon attack with Fear, you gain a Hope.

items.name: Echo Blade
items.description: Doubled Up: When you succeed on an attack with your primary weapon, you can deal damage to another target within Melee range.

items.name: Möbius Orb
items.description: Recursive: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die and add the result to the total damage. This feature can trigger repeatedly.

items.name: Blackblood Tendril
items.description: Poisonous: When a target marks any number of Hit Points from an attack you rolled with Fear, they mark an equal number of Stress.

items.description: Cumbersome: −1 to Finesse.

items.name: Enchanter's Robes
items.description: Mnemonic: Once per scene, you can recall a domain card from your vault without paying its Recall Cost.

items.name: Hawkguard's Mantle
items.description: Gliding: You can glide up to Far range and are immune to damage from falling.

items.name: Spidersilk Tunic
items.description: Wall-Crawling: +1 Evasion; you can walk on walls as easily as on the ground.

items.name: Stormthread Habit
items.description: Absorbing: Once per scene when you take magic damage, you can clear an Armor Slot.

items.name: Wyrdwood Splint Armor
items.description: Quick-Striding: You can't be Restrained and can move up to Far range as part of an action roll.

items.name: Trollhide Cuirass
items.description: Self-Healing: When you take a rest, clear an Armor Slot.

items.name: Gilded Sunplate
items.description: Resplendent: Once per scene when you spend Hope, you can clear an Armor Slot.

items.description: Magnificent: Gain a bonus to your Armor Score equal to your Presence.

items.name: Astral Raiment
items.description: Stellar: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on a Spellcast roll.

items.name: Cloverweave Cloak
items.description: Fortune-Favored: Once per scene, you can change a failure with Hope into a success with Fear.

items.name: Skywarden's Lamellar
items.description: Vigilant: +2 to Evasion.

items.name: Bloodstone Plate Armor
items.description: Bloodthirsty: When you critically succeed on a weapon attack within Melee range, clear a Hit Point.

items.name: Deep-Forged Coral Armor
items.description: Aquatic: You can breathe underwater and gain advantage on Agility Rolls while submerged.

items.name: Darkweave Shroud
items.description: Ghostwalker: Once per rest, mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

items.name: Godbound Laminar
items.description: Divine: When you mark an Armor Slot, gain a Hope.

items.name: Circle-Forged Dreadplate
items.description: Accursed: When you mark any number of Hit Points from an attack, roll a d4. On a result of 4, the attacker must mark an equal number of Stress.

items.name: Rune-Forged Exosuit
items.description: Attuned: The maximum number of domain cards in your loadout is reduced by one, but you gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your tier.

items.name: Hallowed Heroplate
items.description: Blessed: Once per long rest, you can spend any number of Hope before you make the Risk It All death move. You gain a bonus to the result of your Hope Die equal to the number of Hope spent.

items.name: Resonant Harness
items.description: Vitreous: When you would take Severe or greater damage, you can mark 2 Armor Slots to negate that damage. If you do, you gain a −5 penalty to your damage thresholds until you choose to repair your armor as a downtime move.

items.name: Caltrops
items.description: You can spread these caltrops in a Very Close area around you. A creature hastening through that area must mark a Stress.

items.name: Grapnel
items.description: You gain advantage on action rolls to climb sheer surfaces.

items.name: Ball Bearings
items.description: This pouch contains perfectly smooth metal spheres.

items.name: Box of Dragon Dust
items.description: This snuffbox is filled with combustible powder.

items.name: Nighthawker's Ring
items.description: Spend a Hope to activate the gemstone in this ring until the end of the scene. While active, the gemstone changes color to indicate the wearer's proximity to hidden treasure: warm colors for near, cool colors for far.

items.name: Elven Spyglass
items.description: You can use this spyglass to magnify your vision a hundredfold.

items.name: Gourmet Granules
items.description: This savory powder makes any food it's sprinkled on delicious and healthy, no matter how bland or rotten it is.

items.name: Collapsible Pole
items.description: You can break down this 18-foot pole into six interlinked 3-foot segments.

items.name: Blackwing Quill
items.description: This writing quill never runs out of ink or needs to be sharpened.

items.name: Silee's Folding Knife
items.description: This 3-inch blade has an edge that easily cuts through anything except the handle it's stored in.

items.name: Windup Toy
items.description: This small mechanical device is shaped like a strixwolf pup and can be programmed to perform simple tricks.

items.name: Loaded Dice
items.description: You can choose what result this set of weighted dice rolls with a successful Finesse Roll (14). If you roll with Fear, anyone watching knows the dice are loaded.

items.name: Hollowbark Horn
items.description: You can blow this horn to summon a small woodland creature to perform a simple task.

items.name: Self-Tying Rope
items.description: You can command this rope to tie or untie itself.

items.name: Thief's Compass
items.description: This compass points the way toward the nearest exit while indoors and the closest entrance while outdoors.

items.name: Traveler's Bell
items.description: Once per long rest, you can ring this bell to magically open the shortest safe path through rough terrain for 1 hour.

items.name: Mandragorian Torch
items.description: This torch gives off light only the bearer can see.

items.name: Boots of Supple Mystique
items.description: While wearing these boots, you don't leave tracks or footprints.

items.name: Zephyr's Jar
items.description: You can open this empty jar during inclement weather to capture the storm and leave behind clear skies. The storm remains inside until unleashed by reopening the jar.

items.name: Returning Ring
items.description: When you throw your primary weapon while wearing this ring, the weapon appears in your hand immediately after the attack.

items.name: Kingfisher's Net
items.description: Once per long rest, you can use this net to scoop one live fish out of any amount of water, no matter how unlikely it is for that water to have fish in it.

items.name: Titan's Girdle
items.description: Once per scene, you can activate this girdle to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next attack.

items.name: Iron Veil
items.description: This chain-link head covering renders the wearer invisible to fey creatures.

items.name: Furball Bag
items.description: Once per rest, you can produce 2d20 harmless, cat-sized fur creatures of indeterminate origin and species from this bag.

items.name: Whisperstep Anklet
items.description: This anklet makes your steps silent as long as you don't move faster than walking speed.

items.name: Enchanter's Loupe
items.description: You can use this loupe to see through illusions and enchantments.

items.name: Escher's Mirrorball
items.description: Once per long rest, you can command this fist-sized silver orb to capture an omnidirectional image of its surroundings on its surface. This image lasts until your next long rest.

items.name: Cheater's Coin
items.description: When you flip this coin, you can spend a Hope to determine which side it lands on.

items.name: Gravewarden's Bell
items.description: This bell rings when a ghost or undead creature moves within Far range of it.

items.name: Reliquary of the Sightless Saint
items.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Hope Die when you make the Risk It All death move.

items.name: Map of Revelation
items.description: You can attune this map to one creature at a time. The map always shows the attuned creature's location.

items.name: Dagginae's Obsidian Slate
items.description: This wafer-thin sheet of volcanic glass is used by archivists to keep notes. Any information etched onto its surface disappears but can be recalled via a command you set.

items.name: Gadiman's Backpack
items.description: Once per rest, you can spend a Hope to conjure a mundane item up to a cubic foot in size inside this satchel.

items.name: Eclipse Coin
items.description: Once per rest, flip a coin. On heads, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls until your next successful attack. On tails, you gain +1 to your Evasion until an attack fails against you.

items.name: Sorcerer's Hat
items.description: This conical blue hat is covered in silver stars. Once per rest, you can cast a spell from your vault with a Recall Cost equal to or less than your tier. This doesn't work for permanently vaulted cards.

items.name: Ghoulskin Gloves
items.description: When you attack with a physical weapon while wearing these gloves, the damage is considered both physical and magic.

items.name: Gloves of Alacrity
items.description: When you would mark a Stress to reload a weapon, you don't mark it.

items.name: Insomniac's Periapt
items.description: When you take a rest without clearing Hit Points or Stress, you gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls until your next rest.

items.name: Wildrider's Saddle
items.description: This saddle grants any animal it's strapped onto the ability to understand their rider's commands.

items.name: Soul-Twin Circlets
items.description: Two creatures can wear this pair of circlets. You can spend a Hope to switch places with whoever is wearing the other circlet.

items.name: Namer's Oracle
items.description: Once per session, you can roll this set of runic dice to reveal the full name of the last person you touched.

items.name: Crucible Frames
items.description: These eyeglasses reveal weak points in objects and creatures. Three times per rest, you can spend a Hope to gain advantage on an attack roll.

items.name: Two-Faced Aegis Brooch
items.description: Once per rest, flip a coin. On heads, you become immune to the next physical damage you take. On tails, you become immune to the next magic damage you take.

items.name: Knockback Bracelets
items.description: On a successful weapon attack, you can knock your target back up to Close range from their location.

items.name: Force Disc
items.description: This shimmering two-dimensional disc of magical force has a 4-foot diameter and is magically tethered to a pebble. The disc always floats 3 feet north of, and at the same elevation as, the pebble. The pebble has a mass equal to one-hundredth of the total mass carried by the disc.

items.name: Molepaw Mittens
items.description: Spend a Hope to swim through earth as if it were water for the next 10 minutes.

items.name: Timekeeper's Pendant
items.description: You can choose an additional downtime move each rest.

items.name: Iron Dagger Pendant
items.description: Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to tell the pendant a creature's name. The pendant gently pulls you toward that creature's current location until your next long rest.

items.name: Collar of Ascendancy
items.description: An animal who wears this collar gains the ability to speak and understand common speech.

items.name: Temporal Sanctuary
items.description: A PC who takes a rest in the temporal sanctuary can choose an additional downtime move.

items.name: Hero's Helm
items.description: When you critically succeed on an attack, all allies within Close range gain a Hope.

items.name: Rings of Friendship
items.description: Two creatures can wear this pair of rings shaped like coiled snakes. You can spend the Hope of whoever is wearing the other ring (with their permission) as if it were your own.

items.name: Rings of Camaraderie
items.description: Two creatures can wear this pair of wooden rings. You can mark the Stress of whoever is wearing the other ring (with their permission) as if it were your own.

items.name: Rings of Alliance
items.description: Two creatures can wear this pair of rose gold rings. Once per session, you can initiate a Tag Team Roll with whoever is wearing the other ring without spending Hope or counting against your session limit for Tag Team Rolls.

items.name: Phobophage's Circlet
items.description: When the GM spends a Fear, roll a d4. Once per scene on a result of 4, you clear a Stress.

items.name: Quillshawl
items.description: If an adversary attacks you within Melee range, they must succeed on a Reaction Roll (12) or mark a Hit Point.

items.name: Warp Pendant
items.description: Once per rest, mark a Stress to teleport to a location you can clearly see.

items.name: Portal Frames
items.description: This pair of small ornate frames, one red and one blue, are connected. Anything that passes into one exits from the other.

items.name: Communion Relic
items.description: Once per rest, you can spend a Hope to use an ally's Experience as if it were your own. You can carry only one relic.

items.name: Augur's Relic
items.description: Once per long rest, you can activate your Hope feature without spending Hope. You can carry only one relic.

items.name: Warding Candle
items.description: You can light this candle to fill an area within Close range with a halo of light. A creature outside the halo can't enter it if they have ill intent toward a creature within it. The candle burns for an hour.

items.name: Iridian Dust
items.description: This multicolored powder sticks to everything and prevents creatures covered in it from becoming Hidden.

items.name: Verglasian Seed
items.description: You can use this ice shard to instantly freeze an area of water up to Close range.

items.name: Cupbearer's Bezoar
items.description: You can swallow this bezoar to become immune to poisons until your next long rest.

items.name: Mossmantle Potion
items.description: You can drink this tea to perfectly blend into natural environments until your next rest.

items.name: Lyrebird Lozenge
items.description: You can dissolve this lozenge in your mouth to perfectly mimic any voice you've heard until the end of the scene.

items.name: Vial of Featherfall
items.description: You can drink this potion to ignore damage from falling for the next 10 minutes.

items.name: Chimeric Saliva
items.description: You can apply this saliva to a weapon that deals physical damage to change its damage type to magic until your next rest.

items.name: Packet of Space Dust
items.description: This dust causes anything it covers to become lighter than air. One packet contains enough dust to cover the contents of a picnic basket, and the effects last for an hour.

items.name: Pipeweed
items.description: When you choose the Clear Stress downtime move during a short rest, you can smoke this non-intoxicating leaf to clear an additional Stress. Any other PCs who chose the Clear Stress downtime move also gain this benefit.

items.name: Deathseer's Powder
items.description: You can sprinkle this powder over a recently deceased corpse to conjure a spectral reprise of their final minute of life.

items.name: Slayer's Salt
items.description: You can spread this salt in a line along windowsills or thresholds to create a magical barrier that undead creatures can't cross until the line is broken.

items.name: Yakamel Milk
items.description: After consuming this milk, the next time you clear 1 or more Hit Points, you clear an additional Hit Point.

items.name: Glowmoss Mushroom
items.description: You can break this mushroom into pieces, causing it to glow bright blue until your next long rest.

items.name: Red Ooze Oil
items.description: You can coat your weapon in this oil. The next successful attack you make with this weapon deals an extra 1d8 magic damage and temporarily Ignites the target. While Ignited, the target takes 1d4 magic damage when they take the spotlight.

items.name: Instant Camp
items.description: You can unfold this small mechanical box into a camping tent large enough to safely house six people. The tent collapses at the end of your next long rest.

items.name: Bundle of Spiderlegs
items.description: You can eat these spiderlegs to walk on walls until your next rest.

items.name: Ciscan Fog Bottle
items.description: You can break this jar to fill the area within Close range with magical mist. A creature who enters the mist clears a Stress and becomes Hidden.

items.name: Snapthorn Seed
items.description: You can throw this seed at a point you can see. It explodes into a tangle of binding vines that temporarily Restrains all creatures within Close range of that point.

items.name: Sprite Bottle
items.description: When you mark your last Hit Point, this bottle shatters to release the Sprite inside. The Sprite clears all your Hit Points before fading from the Mortal Realm.

items.name: Gravity Bomb
items.description: You can throw this peach-sized mechanical orb at a point within Far range. It implodes and pulls all creatures and objects within Close range of that point into Melee range with it.

items.name: Gossip Flower
items.description: You can plant this seed in soil. It instantly grows into a small flower that records everything it hears for up to one week. When plucked, the flower recites what it recorded in real time, then withers.

items.name: Displacement Token
items.description: You can swallow this token to conjure two illusions of yourself that you can control. Each illusion lasts until it takes damage or until your next rest.

items.name: Night Hag's Dust
items.description: You can blow this dust in an adversary's face to prevent them from clearing Stress until your next long rest.

items.name: Self-Sewing Thread
items.description: You can use this thread to clear either a Hit Point or 2 Armor Slots.

items.name: Stonemason's Fortune
items.description: When you throw this gray brick on the ground, it immediately grows into a 6-foot-tall, 10-foot-wide, and 2-foot-deep wall of solid stone.

items.name: Mnemonic Potion
items.description: You can drink this potion to Utilize an Experience without spending a Hope.

items.name: Salamander Salve
items.description: You can apply this salve to your skin to make yourself immune to heat until your next rest.

items.name: Green Ooze Oil
items.description: You can coat your weapon in this oil. The next successful attack you make with this weapon deals an extra 1d8 magic damage and temporarily Corrodes the target. While Corroded, the target gains a −2 penalty to their damage thresholds.

items.name: Sunlight Orb
items.description: You can shatter this orb to make the area within Very Far range appear as though it's sunlit daytime for the next 24 hours.

items.name: Moonlight Orb
items.description: You can shatter this orb to make the area within Very Far range appear as though it's moonlit nighttime for the next 24 hours.

items.name: Midas Flask
items.description: You can pour this small flask of alchemical liquid over a mundane item to instantly transmute it into a handful of gold.

items.name: Staff of Reversal
items.description: You can break this staff against the ground to reverse one magical transformation or effect within Far range.

items.name: Berserker's Brew
items.description: When you drink this dram of liquid, you gain a bonus to your Strength and a penalty to your Finesse and Knowledge equal to your Instinct (minimum 1). This effect lasts until you make a death move or until your next rest.

items.name: Emberite Shard
items.description: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become temporarily Ablaze. While Ablaze, a creature must roll a d4 whenever they make an action roll. On a result of 1, they mark a Hit Point. On a result of 4, they clear the Ablaze condition.

items.name: Arcticite Shard
items.description: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained by ice.

items.name: Fulgurite Shard
items.description: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and mark 1d4 Stress as lightning crackles through the area.

items.name: Demiurge's Draught
items.description: You can drink this draught to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next successful attack roll.

items.name: Cockerel Claw Tea
items.description: You can drink this tea to refresh your features as if you had taken a long rest.

items.name: Potion of Vigilance
items.description: You can drink this potion to gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion until you mark a Hit Point.

items.name: Cacophonous Concoction
items.description: When you drink this potion, anything you say or do in the next hour becomes impossible for a witness to recount. Any attempts they make to communicate what they saw, heard, or otherwise sensed comes out garbled or nonsensical.

items.name: Nightmare Mead
items.description: You can drink this potion to discover the deepest fear of the next person you make eye contact with. When you do, the GM gains a Fear.

items.name: Stake of Abjuration
items.description: You can hammer this stake into the ground and make a proclamation. Until your next rest, a creature within Far range of the stake who transgresses that proclamation must mark a Stress. The stake lasts until your next rest, then it shatters.

items.name: Psychopomp's Shroud
items.description: You can place this shroud over the corpse of a recently deceased creature. The creature's spirit enters the shroud and becomes your spectral assistant until the next sunrise, when they pass through the veil of death and take the shroud with them.

items.name: Phial of Deep Ink
items.description: You can drink this bottle of ink to transform into a cephalopod of roughly your size for the next hour. You gain rubbery skin, soft bones, the ability to breathe underwater, and new limbs until you have eight total.

items.name: Mesmer's Tonic
items.description: When you drink this tonic, the only thing you can hear until your next rest are the surface thoughts of creatures within Very Close range.

items.name: Invisibility Potion
items.description: You are Hidden until you deal damage to another creature or until your next rest.

items.name: Formoid Serum
items.description: You can drink this potion to become a swarm of 16 million ants until the end of the scene. You keep and have access to all equipment, loot, and features.

items.name: Steelskin Salve
items.description: You can apply this salve to your skin to gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your tier until the end of the scene.

items.name: Godling's Pomelo
items.description: You can eat this citrus fruit to clear all Hit Points and Stress.

items.name: Snakeskin Spirit
items.description: You can drink this potion to slough off your outer layer of skin and heal a scar.

items.name: Magic-User's Malison
items.description: When you release this spellcaster's trapped soul, you can cast one spell from a card in your vault as if it were in your loadout. This doesn't work for permanently vaulted cards.

items.name: Quintessential Severant
items.description: You can use this magic blade to cut one magical or metaphysical bond, such as an enchantment, contract, magical tether, or divine oath. When you do, the blade shatters.

items.name: Mask of the Echoed Self
items.description: You can wear this mask during your next level up to swap the values of any of your traits. When you do, the mask becomes your permanent face.

items.name: Necroprancer's Bell
items.description: You can break this rusted, clapperless bell against the ground to summon a skeletal steed that climbs out of the earth and serves you until the next sunrise.

items.name: Drakemantle
items.description: You can use this enchanted ancient dragon hide to gain draconic characteristics until the end of the scene, when the hide falls away in tatters. Until then, you can fly and gain a +5 bonus to your damage thresholds and a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.

items.name: Gambler's Fallacy
items.description: You can spend any number of handfuls of gold by placing them into this slotted ceramic jar shaped like a pig. When you throw the jar at a point within Far range, it explodes and deals 1d20 magic damage for each handful of gold spent to all creatures within Close range of that point. All gold within the jar is destroyed.

items.name: Lionheart Tonic
items.description: You can drink this tonic to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency until you roll with Fear.

items.name: Tears of the Undying Hero
items.description: When you drink this potion, death can't touch you until your next long rest. When you would mark your last Hit Point, instead of making a death move, you make one final action roll before falling into a dreamless slumber until an ally chooses the Tend to Wounds downtime move to clear your Hit Points.

items.name: Featherstep Potion
items.description: You can drink this potion to sprout small wings from your ankles that give you a bonus to your Evasion equal to your tier until your next rest.
